description.en: Signs in with ChatGPT (SIWC) and shares the 1455 callback port with the legacy Codex plugin — link one at a time. Official Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC) route onto the public OpenAI Responses endpoint: OAuth access token as Bearer, a request shaped the way a subscription sign-in takes one (store:false, stream:true, no OpenAI-hosted tools, the conversation keyed so its prompt cache is reused), and the subscription's own model catalog. Shares the 1455 callback port with the legacy Codex plugin — link one at a time, not both at once.
description.zh: 以「使用 ChatGPT 登录」(SIWC) 接入，回跳端口 1455 与旧 Codex 插件相同——请勿同时发起两份登录。 官方“使用 ChatGPT 登录”（SIWC）接入公共 OpenAI Responses 端点：OAuth 访问令牌作 Bearer，请求按订阅登录的要求整形（store:false、stream:true、不携带由 OpenAI 托管的工具、按会话命名以复用提示缓存），模型目录取自订阅本身。回跳端口 1455 与旧 Codex 插件相同——请勿同时发起两份登录。
